quantity.description: Number of physical units to create (each gets its own number)

parentId.description: Categories nest; null at the top of a tree.

depreciationRatePercent.description: A string, not a number: the column is `Decimal(5,2)`, and Prisma hands a Decimal back as its string form so no precision is lost on the way.

isUsable.description: Whether an asset in this condition may still be lent out.

allowTransactions.description: Whether an asset in this status may be borrowed or returned.

systemKey.description: Set only on the statuses the workflow reasons about, so renaming one in the interface cannot change what the code does with it.

expectedReturnDate.description: Expected date of returning the assets

unitIds.description: IDs of the asset units to borrow

returnedConditionId.description: Condition ID of the asset when returned

approverRoleCode.description: Role code authorized to approve this step (e.g. ADMIN, PRINCIPAL)

isMandatory.description: False leaves this step to the previous approver, who decides per request whether it is also taken. A mandatory step is always taken.

action.description: Action to perform: APPROVE or REJECT

forwardToNextApprover.description: Forward this loan to the next approver instead of finishing here. Only meaningful when the next step is optional — a mandatory one is always taken, and this cannot waive it. Ignored on a rejection.
